title: Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): Pyramids of Giza, Great Zimbabwe, Lalibela, Timbuktu, Fort Jesus, Olduvai Gorge.

skills.key_step: The child places historical sites in Africa, says why they matter and picks ways to conserve them.

floor.question: Give one reason a historic site is important.

steps: Pick a way to conserve it.

misconceptions.ask: In which country is Great Zimbabwe?
misconceptions.repair: Find the sites on a map of Africa.
Ask what we would lose without them.

listen_for: Climb the walls and write names
misconceptions.ask: How should visitors behave at a historical site?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens when everyone writes on a wall.
Pin it on the Africa map.
